title: Enable eco-conscious enterprises
summary: Explore suitable technology, design, learning and digital-operation support for makers and small sellers.
detail: The intended pathway starts with how an enterprise actually works and what capacity it has. Any support should fit that reality, respect the maker's agency and avoid implying environmental certification.
problem: Small enterprises may face fragmented tools, limited digital capacity and difficult routes to customers without needing an oversized platform.
provides: Learning and market-access experiments where approved
exclusions: Automatic grants, free services or guaranteed sales
Independent certification of a seller or product
Claims that handmade goods are automatically better for the environment
process: Understand the business and its constraints, identify a priority gap, agree a proportionate support plan, then review practical usefulness.
expectedOutputs: A prioritised operational or growth need
An agreed tool, workflow or capability response
modelNote: Proposed only. Selection, capacity, commercial or subsidised terms, and environmental-claims standards are not yet published.
